identity_policy.acceptance: Accepted battle, adventure and portrait assets require checksum-bound native-size identity review under assets/reviews.
identity_policy.rule: Independent Ionian identities: three walking-melee lines, two finite ranged lines and two flying-melee lines. Kashuri local firearm defenders, voluntary Jeweled Protectors and recruitable living Empyrean dragons are explicit project adaptations, never mass-produced champions. No original or other Runeterra troop recolors.

original_resource_references: Structure and rendering language only: original Heroes III creature, town and siege layouts measured for scale.
release_policy: Every required output needs an approved source, a recorded checksum, redistribution rights and native-size visual acceptance. No placeholders.
visual_direction: Original Heroes III Rampart/Castle native painted compatibility; living roots, carved red-brown timber, jade-grey masonry, curved roofs and inhabited misty terraces. Restrained spirit light, independent Ionian silhouettes, larger foreground buildings and seven dwellings upgraded in place.
